coverage_issues: qwen model had a JSONDecodeError tool failure when reviewing aur-auto-vote.timer, preventing completion of its audit
learnings: Tool errors (JSONDecodeError, timeouts, crashes) should not force an inconclusive verdict when another model has successfully reviewed the same files - the system should recognize when coverage gaps are filled by alternative reports
The audit orchestration should distinguish between 'model could not parse this file' and 'model found this file suspicious' - a parsing failure is not a security signal
When multiple models review the same package, a tool error in one should be weighted against successful coverage from another rather than automatically triggering escalation
